name: Bard x Rogue
source:
A short love story between an anxious bard and an unusually flashy rogue set in a fantasy world. You play as Dreegan, a young dhampir that belongs to a bard traveling group. You meet Nev, a bard in the soul, but he is actually a rogue. What mysteries does Nev hide?  

[From [url=https://piniaart.itch.io/bard-x-r]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个发生在奇幻世界中的、焦虑的吟游诗人和异常华丽的盗贼之间的简短爱情故事。你扮演德里根，一个年轻的吸血裔，属于一个吟游诗人旅行团。你遇到了内夫，一个灵魂中的吟游诗人，但他实际上是一个盗贼。内夫隐藏着什么秘密？

[来自[url=https://piniaart.itch.io/bard-x-r]Itch.io[/url]]
